note: Sierra NF campground across the road from Bass Lake, in a grove of oak, pine and cedar; shaded sites clustered close together on short paved and dirt spurs. Tight turns: the agency calls it unsuitable for large travel trailers or RVs. Register at the Bass Lake camp store. The 2.6-mile Spring Cove Trail starts in camp. --Claude
